// CASE canonical_control expect=pass
Future<List<R>> mapWithConcurrency<T, R>(
  List<T> items,
  int width,
  Future<R> Function(T) operation,
) async {
  final results = <R>[];
  for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
    final group = items.skip(offset).take(width);
    results.addAll(await Future.wait(group.map(operation)));
  }
  return results;
}

// CASE outer_page_loop_wraps_chunk expect=fire
Future<List<Receipt>> sendAllPages(
  List<Page> pages,
  int width,
  Future<Receipt> Function(Order) send,
) async {
  final results = <Receipt>[];
  for (final page in pages) {
    final orders = page.orders;
    for (var offset = 0; offset < orders.length; offset += width) {
      final group = orders.skip(offset).take(width);
      results.addAll(await Future.wait(group.map(send)));
    }
  }
  return results;
}

// CASE outer_while_retry_wraps_chunk expect=fire
Future<List<R>> mapRetrying<T, R>(
  List<T> items,
  int width,
  Future<R> Function(T) operation,
) async {
  final results = <R>[];
  var round = 0;
  while (round < 3) {
    for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
      final group = items.skip(offset).take(width);
      results.addAll(await Future.wait(group.map(operation)));
    }
    round++;
  }
  return results;
}

// CASE serial_loop_after_chunk expect=fire
Future<List<R>> mapThenAudit<T, R>(
  List<T> items,
  int width,
  Future<R> Function(T) operation,
) async {
  final results = <R>[];
  for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
    final group = items.skip(offset).take(width);
    results.addAll(await Future.wait(group.map(operation)));
  }
  for (final result in results) {
    await audit(result);
  }
  return results;
}

// CASE extra_await_in_chunk_body expect=fire
Future<List<R>> mapWithAudit<T, R>(
  List<T> items,
  int width,
  Future<R> Function(T) operation,
) async {
  final results = <R>[];
  for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
    final group = items.skip(offset).take(width);
    await audit(group);
    results.addAll(await Future.wait(group.map(operation)));
  }
  return results;
}

// CASE chunk_in_if expect=pass
Future<List<R>> mapMaybe<T, R>(
  List<T> items,
  int width,
  Future<R> Function(T) operation,
) async {
  final results = <R>[];
  if (items.isNotEmpty) {
    for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
      final group = items.skip(offset).take(width);
      results.addAll(await Future.wait(group.map(operation)));
    }
  }
  return results;
}

// CASE two_chunk_loops_in_outer_for expect=fire
Future<List<R>> mapGroups<T, R>(
  List<List<T>> groups,
  int width,
  Future<R> Function(T) operation,
) async {
  final results = <R>[];
  for (final items in groups) {
    for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
      final group = items.skip(offset).take(width);
      results.addAll(await Future.wait(group.map(operation)));
    }
  }
  return results;
}

// CASE prelude_await_no_loop expect=pass
Future<List<R>> mapAfterWarm<T, R>(
  List<T> items,
  int width,
  Future<R> Function(T) operation,
) async {
  await warmUp();
  final results = <R>[];
  for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
    final group = items.skip(offset).take(width);
    results.addAll(await Future.wait(group.map(operation)));
  }
  return results;
}

// CASE void_business_chunk_no_return expect=fire
Future<void> sendInChunks(
  List<Order> orders,
  Future<void> Function(Order) send,
) async {
  final results = <void>[];
  for (var offset = 0; offset < orders.length; offset += 10) {
    final group = orders.skip(offset).take(10);
    results.addAll(await Future.wait(group.map(send)));
  }
}

// CASE nested_closure_serial_in_helper expect=fire
Future<List<R>> mapWithHook<T, R>(
  List<T> items,
  int width,
  Future<R> Function(T) operation,
) async {
  final results = <R>[];
  Future<void> warmAll() async {
    for (final item in items) {
      await warm(item);
    }
  }

  await warmAll();
  for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
    final group = items.skip(offset).take(width);
    results.addAll(await Future.wait(group.map(operation)));
  }
  return results;
}

// CASE do_while_wraps_chunk expect=fire
Future<List<R>> mapUntilDone<T, R>(
  List<T> items,
  int width,
  Future<R> Function(T) operation,
) async {
  final results = <R>[];
  var pass = 0;
  do {
    for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
      final group = items.skip(offset).take(width);
      results.addAll(await Future.wait(group.map(operation)));
    }
    pass++;
  } while (pass < 2);
  return results;
}

// CASE try_wraps_chunk expect=pass
Future<List<R>> mapGuarded<T, R>(
  List<T> items,
  int width,
  Future<R> Function(T) operation,
) async {
  final results = <R>[];
  try {
    for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
      final group = items.skip(offset).take(width);
      results.addAll(await Future.wait(group.map(operation)));
    }
  } finally {
    log('done');
  }
  return results;
}
